values.quote: Photosynthesis – sunlight supplies the energy to convert carbon dioxide and water to glucose and oxygen.
Photosynthesis: The process used by plants to convert carbon dioxide and water into oxygen and sugars (food), using energy from the sun.
Chemosynthesis: The process by which microbes create sugars (food) using energy released from chemical reactions.
Chemosynthesis – hydrogen sulfide supplies the energy to convert carbon dioxide and water to glucose and hydrogen sulfide.
